title: SAM.gov opportunity changes

outcome.description: match, dated no-change result, or uncertain — please check

solicitation_number.description: Solicitation number when present in SAM.gov

naics_code.description: Watched NAICS code associated with the notice

previous_deadline.description: Response deadline observed in the earlier snapshot

response_deadline.description: Response deadline observed in the latest snapshot

previous_amendment.description: Amendment or version in the earlier snapshot

amendment.description: Amendment or version in the latest snapshot

source_url.description: Public SAM.gov notice URL or official API endpoint

checked_at.description: UTC timestamp from the latest completed snapshot

limitations.description: Coverage and uncertainty notes for this result
